_comment: Central configuration and asset manifest. Leave a value empty ("") to show the reserved placeholder for it. Paths are relative to the repository root and must be inside assets/.

site.name: ShrimpPulse
site._thaiCalendar_help: "buddhist" renders Thai dates in พ.ศ. (e.g. ธันวาคม 2568); "gregorian" keeps ค.ศ. years. Underlying dates never change.

release._help: Status labels (available / developing / planned / considering) are defined once in content/<lang>/common.json under "status". Per-feature statuses live in content/<lang>/capabilities.json.

links._help: lineUrl: the official LINE add-friend link for ShrimpPulse 2.0. lineQrImage: a QR image you generate from that real link (never auto-generated here). While empty, buttons point visitors to the access-information section instead.

contact._help: Shown on the Progress & Participation page. While empty, a reserved contact area is displayed.

images._help: Set each key to a path such as assets/images/photos/farm-visit.jpg. Alt text and captions are edited in content/<lang>/*.json next to the matching placeholder.

founder.en: Antibiotic resistance will have devastating consequences if left unchecked. In creating ShrimpPulse, I hope to channel the powers of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help aquaculture communities ameliorate this issue.
founder.th: ปัญหาการดื้อยาปฏิชีวนะจะส่งผลกระทบร้ายแรงหากปล่อยไว้โดยไม่มีการแก้ไข ด้วยการพัฒนา ShrimpPulse ผมหวังที่จะนำศักยภาพของปัญญาประดิษฐ์ (AI) มาใช้เพื่อช่วยให้ชุมชนผู้เพาะเลี้ยงสัตว์น้ำสามารถบรรเทาปัญหานี้ได้

quotes._help: A short personal quotation shown on the Why ShrimpPulse page. Leave both empty to keep the reserved space.

updates._help: A short dated update shown on the Progress & Participation page.

people._help: Names and organisations referenced across the site via {{people.key}} tokens in content files. Thai personal names are kept in Latin script by default so that no real name is misspelled; replace them with the correct Thai spellings when confirmed.

reviewerAffiliation.en: Aquaculture Business Research Centre, Kasetsart University
reviewerAffiliation.th: ศูนย์วิจัยธุรกิจเพาะเลี้ยงสัตว์น้ำ มหาวิทยาลัยเกษตรศาสตร์
